changelog: Fix: after an MCP model applies ratings, Chaperone now runs its own scan 2 minutes later (not just a library scan), so albums pick up their tracks' new ratings right away instead of at the next daily run.
description: Fills in missing parental ratings so Jellyfin parental controls work across the whole library: explicit/clean music from Deezer, MusicBrainz, Apple Music and LRCLIB lyrics; movies and shows from TMDb; anime from MyAnimeList; fan edits from their source. Built-in MCP server lets an AI model research the rest, with verified evidence and admin review.
name: Chaperone
overview: Automatic parental ratings for music, movies, shows and anime, plus an MCP server for the hard ones.
